item.title: New recipe: Hotspots: Volcanic Activity Map
item.description: Created by community member nikokoren. Enable and ease off the pressure, else you might explode.
item.content:encoded:
Hotspots: Volcanic Activity Map : See where the Earth runs hot

By IsarWorks · nature, education

Created by community member nikokoren. Enable and ease off the pressure, else you might explode.

TRMNL announcement

From the author (About This Plugin)

Ever wonder which volcanoes are running hot right now? Hotspots gives you a global view.<br><br> Hotspots turns NASA satellite observations of thermal activity into a minimalist map of the world's volcanoes.<br><br> Each known volcano gets its own little marker, sized according to the relative thermal activity detected by satellites.<br><br>Hotspots also checks the Smithsonian's Global Volcanism Program for reported ongoing eruptions. Volcanoes listed as erupting get a little ash plume, so you can tell them apart from volcanoes showing a heat signal alone.<br><br>As observations age, the markers fade, so you can see where activity has been spotted recently without drowning in data.

Install the recipe on trmnl.com

item.title: New recipe: Bernd Stromberg Quotes
item.description: Created by community member Marcel Voß. Enable because it would also be nice if the cow laid eggs! But she doesn't.
item.content:encoded:
Bernd Stromberg Quotes : Random German quotes from Stromberg

By Marcel Voß · humor, entertainment

Created by community member Marcel Voß. Enable because it would also be nice if the cow laid eggs! But she doesn't.

TRMNL announcement

From the author (About This Plugin)

<p>Bring the dry office humor of the German TV series Stromberg to your TRMNL. This plugin displays random German-language quotes with the character's name, turning a spare corner of your dashboard into a regular dose of workplace satire. The quotes remain in their original German.</p>
<p>The layout supports all four TRMNL sizes: full screen, horizontal half, vertical half and quadrant. It adapts to TRMNL OG and TRMNL X in landscape and portrait orientation. Images keep their proportions, while text size adjusts to the quote length. Very long quotes may be shortened with an ellipsis in smaller views to keep the screen readable.</p>
<p>Install the plugin, add it to your playlist and enjoy. No API key, separate account or external setup is required. A new quote is fetched every 30 minutes by default; you can adjust the interval in TRMNL. Your display updates according to its playlist and device check-ins.</p>
<p>An independent fan-made plugin, with quotes supplied by the <a href="https://stromberg-api.de/" class="underline" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Stromberg API</a>.</p>

Install the recipe on trmnl.com

Low Expectations : A fresh disappointment. Every day.

By Michael · humor, calendar

Created by community member michael.kurath. Enable and be better than yesterday. Oh sorry, I meant tomorrow.

TRMNL announcement

From the author (About This Plugin)

Low Expectations is a daily tear-off calendar for anyone who has had enough encouragement. Each page pairs the date with a short piece of dry, demotivating advice: a small reminder that tomorrow can bring the same problems in a fresh arrangement.
Choose English or German. The calendar includes 365 paired entries and shows the same entry throughout your local day, even if you refresh it again. The sequence continues through New Year and leap days, then repeats after 365 days.
The design adapts to Full, Half Horizontal, Half Vertical, and Quadrant layouts on TRMNL OG and X, including portrait. Everything is included in the plugin: no quote service, API key, or external account is needed. Created by Michael Kurath.

item.title: New recipe: Abyss
item.description: Created by community member nikokoren. Enable and don't hold your breath.
item.content:encoded:
Abyss : A window into the deep ocean

By IsarWorks · discovery, education

Created by community member nikokoren. Enable and don't hold your breath.

TRMNL announcement

From the author (About This Plugin)

<strong>A window into the abyss.</strong><br>
Turn your TRMNL into your personal window into the deep ocean. Abyss lets you peek into a fascinating corner of our planet: the deep Pacific. Explore hydrothermal vents on Axial Seamount, a methane seep at Southern Hydrate Ridge, and the Oregon Offshore seafloor. These are real research camera images from places most of us will never visit.<br><br>

<strong>Choose your view</strong><br>
Cycle through all four cameras, choose a few favourites, or settle into one. Leave the camera selection empty to rotate through every published camera.<br><br>
The default 15-minute refresh rotates your selected views. Images are processed every three hours from periodic recordings and snapshots. When a camera cannot update, its last good image stays on display.<br><br>

<strong>Where are the cameras?</strong><br>
Four camera views across three research sites in the northeast Pacific. Both vent cameras are on Axial Seamount; the other cameras look across Southern Hydrate Ridge and the Oregon Offshore seafloor. All depths are approximate.<br><br>

<strong>ASHES: Mushroom vent — about 1,540 m</strong><br>
On Axial Seamount, an active underwater volcano on the Juan de Fuca Ridge. This camera looks into the ASHES hydrothermal vent field, where hot fluids emerge from the volcanic seafloor.<br>
<a href="https://interactiveoceans.washington.edu/research-sites/axial-caldera/ashes/">Explore the research site</a> · <a href="https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/media.ooica.net/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/06193730/ASHES-Map-2020.png">Detailed site map</a><br><br>

<strong>International District: Tiny Towers — about 1,520 m</strong><br>
A second hydrothermal vent field on Axial Seamount. The Tiny Towers camera offers another view of the volcano's deep-sea habitat.<br>
<a href="https://interactiveoceans.washington.edu/research-sites/axial-caldera/international-district/">Explore the research site</a> · <a href="https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws

By Aaron Kuehler · analytics, programming

From the author (About This Plugin)

Shows the open errors, slow actions, and uptime and check-in monitors of every app in an AppSignal organization, or of one app.<br/> <br/> <strong>Setup</strong><br/> 1. Click the OAuth <strong>Connect</strong> button and sign in to AppSignal. AppSignal asks you to pick an app, but the plugin can read every app in the organization either way. <p>Little Milestones shows what most children can do at your child's age, plus play ideas, parenting tips and common challenges, from birth to 5 years.</p>
<p>The milestone checklists and many tips come from the CDC's Learn the Signs. Act Early. program (public domain). Other tips and play ideas are paraphrased from AAP (HealthyChildren.org), WHO, NHS, NICHD Safe to Sleep, Harvard Center on the Developing Child, ZERO TO THREE, UNICEF, Raising Children Network and Reach Out and Read.</p>
<p>Every child develops at their own pace. Milestones are a guide, not a test, and this plugin is not medical advice. If you're worried, talk to your child's doctor or health visitor. Don't wait.</p>

item.title: New recipe: Petrol Prices UK
item.description: Created by community member laviathan. Enable and decide to bike instead.
item.content:encoded:
Petrol Prices UK : Lowest reported fuel prices nearby

By laviathan · travel, finance

Created by community member laviathan. Enable and decide to bike instead.

TRMNL announcement

From the author (About This Plugin)

See the lowest reported pump prices near you, from the UK government's official <a href="https://www.gov.uk/guidance/access-the-latest-fuel-prices-and-forecourt-data-via-api-or-email" class="underline">Fuel Finder</a> service. Enter a UK postcode, a search radius and a fuel grade: the screen ranks the three lowest reported prices within that straight-line radius, shows ties honestly, and adds the nearest reporting forecourt for context, together with the time the prices were last synced.<br/><br/> Prices are the pump prices forecourts report before any discounts or loyalty offers. Distances are straight-line, not driving distances. The plugin does not show whether a forecourt is open or has fuel in stock, and it does not estimate savings. Forecourts that do not report to Fuel Finder are not shown, and a forecourt whose reported location is more than 5 miles from its own postcode is placed at its postcode. If prices have not been updated for more than 30 minutes the screen says so instead of showing a leaderboard.<br/><br/> Spotted a wrong price? <a href="https://www.fuel-finder.service.gov.uk/motorist/price-report" class="underline">Report a discrepancy to Fuel Finder</a>.<br/><br/> Contains public sector information licensed under the <a href="https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/" class="underline">Open Government Licence v3.0</a>. Postcode lookup by <a href="https://postcodes.io" class="underline">postcodes.io</a>: contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right; Royal Mail data © Royal Mail copyright and database right; National Statistics data © Crown copyright and database right. Your postcode is sent to the Petrol Prices UK service and postcodes.io only to find its coordinates; it is not logged or linked to your account.

Install the recipe on trmnl.com

<b>Never miss bin night again.</b> Bin Day puts a grumpy rubbish bin, a cheerful recycling bin, a leafy garden bin or a peckish food caddy on your TRMNL the evening before collection, with a fresh bad pun every week. No account, API key or smart home needed: tell it which bins you have, how often each one is collected and one collection date, and it works out the rest, including bank holiday changes and winter breaks for garden waste.<br><br><b>Tip:</b> put it on your playlist for the evening before bin day (e.g. Thursdays 7-8pm for a Friday collection), or leave it on all the time and it tells you what's next. On collection morning it switches to a last-chance reminder until noon.

Gridiron Power Rankings puts the whole NFL power picture on your TRMNL. All 32 teams are ranked by ESPN's Football Power Index, with each team's record, how many spots it moved this week and its chance of making the playoffs. Pick your team and it is highlighted on every layout, or give it the full screen: a poster with its power rank, record, division place, games back and next game, with the kickoff in your time zone. Data comes from ESPN's public power index, standings and schedule, fetched on TRMNL's servers, so there is nothing to sign up for and no API key. Updates once a day.
